messages:
Ethan (Sales): Handoff for SaffronBio 30 signed yesterday. They're asking to start a 60-day Dedicated pilot in us-east-1 with private peering. Key context: heavy embeddings + chat summarization, avg payload ~420 tokens, expected 2k-4k req/day with spikes to 12k/day during daily digest runs. Procurement is asking for a clear pilot run-rate and a short success criteria doc. Privacy: DPA + IP protection required. Can CS/SE/Support have a quick sync Thu 9am ET?

Rosa (CS): I'll own onboarding and weekly enablement. Thu 9am ET OK. I'll open CS-6011 and draft an onboarding runbook (milestones: provisioning, SSO, perf tuning, pilot review). Ethan, please share primary contacts + SAML metadata and any sample payloads. I'll add a feedback capture form to the runbook to surface early quality/regression signals.

Ken (Solutions Eng): Ken here . I'll validate embedding dimensions, recommend quant/profile, and run perf benches with their sample. Ethan, can you drop one sanitized request & vector shape? Typical bench we ask them to run: ```curl -X POST https://bench.redwood.internal/run -d '{"model":"embed-xl","seq":420,"requests":100}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>'```

Samir (Support): I'll prepare private peering checklist and ops runbook (CIDR, allowlist, certs, egress policy). Tagging infra-oncall. Also will add smoke test steps for initial provisioning window.

legal-bot: DPA ticket created LEG-4201  https://contracts.redwood/dpa/4201 (assigned to Legal).

billing-bot: Billing estimate request logged BILL-307 (link: https://billing.redwood/estimates/307).

Rosa (CS): Owners: Ethan = sales liaison, Rosa = CS onboarding lead (CS-6011), Ken = SE for perf & embeddings, Samir = Support/ops for private peering, Legal via LEG-4201, Billing via BILL-307. Next steps on CS-6011: 1) Ethan share SAML metadata + contacts + sample payload; 2) Ken to run perf bench and provide per-route cost numbers and quant/batch recs; 3) Samir publish network allowlist + preflight; 4) Rosa to send invite for Thu 9am ET and draft enablement deck with pilot success criteria (latency, error rate, cost delta).

Ethan (Sales): Shared SAML metadata and 1Password link to sample payloads. Procurement wants a line-item monthly pilot projection (compute, storage for embeddings, egress) and a simple go/no-go checklist after 30 days. They flagged renewal sensitivity 3 high if initial costs look worse than their on-prem baseline.

Ken (Solutions Eng): Running benchmarks now. Initial run results: p50 embed latency ~180ms in us-east-1, vector upsert throughput ~1.8k/min on test vm. Recommend 8-bit quant for encoder and batch size=32 for embeddings to save ~30% on compute. I'll post full bench + per-route cost to CS-6011 by EOD Wed. Also including a fallback lightweight model for peak shedding.

Samir (Support): Network notes (preflight): allowlist 54.210.11.7/32 and 54.210.11.8/32; ports 443 and 8443 for data plane, 22 for admin during provisioning. Adding SSO cert step for admin UI. Checklist attached to CS-6011.

Rosa (CS): I'll prepare enablement deck that includes expected SLOs, cost levers (batching, cache, quant), rollback plan, and the feedback capture link for weekly check-ins. Drafting pilot success criteria: p50 embed <= 250ms, error rate <0.5%, monthly cost within procurement threshold (TBD), and positive feedback from pilot users (>=4/5).

Ethan (Sales): Procurement threshold DM sent to Rosa. Also asked Legal to prioritize LEG-4201 since IP addendum needed before sharing production data.

legal-bot: LEG-4201 linked to CS-6011. Legal notified.

Ken (Solutions Eng): Posted detailed bench to CS-6011: core findings + recommended quant/batch + expected cost per 100k embeddings. Suggest we enable prefix caching for repeated contexts to cut cost further.

Samir (Support): Provisioning window requested 3 week 0. Infra-oncall acknowledged and will validate network during provisioning.

Rosa (CS): Invite sent for Thu 9am ET, ticket CS-6011 created, owners assigned. I'll start weekly enablement next Monday and will capture feedback via the runbook form. If Legal/Billing/procurement blocks appear, flag them here. :thumbsup:

Ethan (Sales): Thanks team, I'll be on the call to intro procurement + technical contacts. Please include line-item cost in the deck.

Ken (Solutions Eng): +1, will include per-route breakdown and a recommended degradation policy.

Samir (Support): +1, checklist uploaded. Ready for provisioning window.

Rosa (CS): Closing loop for now 3 CS-6011 updated, enablement invite sent, feedback form linked. Will post pilot milestones after Thu sync.
